descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare și Bănci
We are looking for an experienced Senior PHP/Drupal Web Developer to design, build, maintain, and improve high-quality web applications. You will take ownership of complex Drupal development work and help ensure that our solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable. You will work closely with designers, backend developers, and other stakeholders, while sharing your expertise with the team.
 Key responsibilities 
Design, develop, customize, and maintain Drupal websites and applications.
Lead the development of complex Drupal modules, themes, and integrations.
Make sound technical decisions and contribute to the architecture of Drupal solutions.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to deliver responsive, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces.
Integrate third-party APIs and services, ensuring reliable data exchange.
Review code, promote coding standards, and support the team in improving development practices.
Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and security issues.
Plan and manage deployments, upgrades, and ongoing site maintenance.
Investigate complex technical issues and guide their resolution.
Maintain technical documentation and share knowledge with colleagues.
Mentor and support other developers where appropriate.
 Required Qualifications 
Several years of professional PHP development experience, including substantial hands-on experience with Drupal 8, 9, or 10.
Strong knowledge of Drupal architecture, module development, and theming with Twig.
Proficiency in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience with relational databases, preferably MySQL.
Strong experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and third-party services.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Strong understanding of web performance, scalability, accessibility, and security best practices.
Experience with code reviews, technical problem-solving, and delivering production-ready solutions.
Ability to take ownership of technical work and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 The gross monthly salary range for this role is RON 50,000–60,000.
 The final salary will be agreed based on a thorough and objective assessment of the candidate’s professional skills, relevant experience and overall profile.
 We Offer 
A Truly Global Workplace – work with professionals from 40+ nationalities, bringing diverse expertise, perspectives, and a collaborative international culture.
Hybrid & Flexible Work – we support work-life balance with remote work options and modern office spaces across Europe.
A Culture of Growth – we invest in your future, offering LinkedIn Learning, mentorship, and professional development programmes, including HiPo and leadership development initiatives to support career advancement.
Financial Growth Opportunities – benefit from our share purchase matching programme, allowing you to invest in your future with matched contributions and long-term financial rewards.
Workation Programme – work remotely from different countries for up to 2 months per year, experiencing new cultures while staying connected and productive.
 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support specific parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses against predefined criteria. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by human recruiters.
